description: Publish to one connected account immediately, instead of scheduling for later. Call list_connected_accounts first to get a valid socialAccountId. The post is picked up by the scheduler within moments, not published synchronously — call list_scheduled_posts afterward to confirm it actually went live.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted immediately after publishing (Facebook and Instagram only)

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible image or video URL to attach, if any

socialAccountId.description: The connected account id to post to, from list_connected_accounts

name: publish_post_now
